## Example 3.9 · (b) {#ss3-example-3-9-b .ap-lesson}

The third term of an arithmetic series is $23$ and the eighth term is $63$.

b\) Deduce the thirtieth term of this series.

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 17 · Example 3.9(b)</p>

::: notes

Using a=7,d=8 from part (a), a_30=7+29(8)=239. Alternatively a_30=a_8+(30−8)d=63+22(8)=239. Retain all source information so the slide is self-contained.

:::
